summaryEn: Today's papers center on the gap between training and deployment: the top paper exposes how LLM RL training-inference mismatch silently harms the deployed policy and proposes a monotonic inference-policy objective. The day extends this systems-and-deployment theme to embodied AI (a portable C++ runtime and a detect-and-correct VLA policy), efficient generation (data-agnostic diffusion quantization, VLM data-curation benchmark), and trustworthiness (multi-layer agent red teaming, multimodal attribution, and measuring the human–LLM research-idea gap).
summaryZh: 今日论文聚焦训练与部署之间的鸿沟：头号论文揭示LLM强化学习的训练-推理失配如何悄悄损害部署侧策略，并提出单调推理策略目标。这一「系统与部署」主题延伸至具身智能（便携C++运行时、检测-纠正VLA策略）、高效生成（数据无关的扩散量化、VLM数据筛选基准）与可信安全（多层智能体红队、多模态归因、人机研究想法差距度量）。

papers.titleEn: The Mirage of Optimizing Training Policies: Monotonic Inference Policies as the Real Objective for LLM Reinforcement Learning
papers.titleZh: 优化训练策略的幻象：以单调推理策略作为LLM强化学习的真正目标
papers.problemEn: LLM RL is fragile because separate training and inference engines assign inconsistent probabilities to the same trajectories, inducing off-policyness — and existing fixes stabilize the training policy while ignoring whether the deployed inference policy actually improves.
papers.problemZh: LLM强化学习脆弱的根源在于训练与推理引擎对同一轨迹给出不一致概率，产生off-policy污染；现有方法只稳定训练侧策略，却忽视了部署侧推理策略是否真正得到提升。
papers.innovationEn: MIPI reframes the objective as monotonic improvement of the inference policy, and the MIPU framework builds sampler-referenced candidate updates then selectively accepts synchronized ones via an inference-side gap proxy.
papers.innovationZh: MIPI将目标重构为对推理策略的单调改进；MIPU框架构建以采样器为参照的候选更新，并通过推理侧间隙代理选择性接受同步候选。
papers.resultEn: On two model scales under high mismatch, MIPU improves average reasoning performance and training stability versus prior off-policy corrections.
papers.resultZh: 在两种模型规模、高失配设定下，MIPU相比现有off-policy校正方法提升了平均推理性能与训练稳定性。

papers.titleEn: Embodied.cpp: A Portable Inference Runtime of Embodied AI Models on Heterogeneous Robots
papers.titleZh: Embodied.cpp：面向异构机器人的具身AI模型便携推理运行时
papers.problemEn: Deploying VLA and world-action models on heterogeneous edge devices is fragmented across model-specific Python stacks, and existing runtimes built for request-response serving violate the closed-loop, multi-rate, latency-first contract of embodied control.
papers.problemZh: 在异构边缘设备上部署VLA与世界-动作模型被各模型专属Python栈割裂；现有面向请求-响应的运行时违反了具身控制所需的闭环、多速率、延迟优先契约。
papers.innovationEn: Embodied.cpp is a portable C++ runtime that captures a shared execution path across VLA/WAM models into five layers (input adapters, sequence builders, backbone, head plugins, deployment adapters), enabling modular multi-rate execution and latency-first fused inference through one backend abstraction.
papers.innovationZh: Embodied.cpp是一款便携C++运行时，将VLA/WAM模型的共享执行路径抽象为五层（输入适配、序列构建、骨干、头部插件、部署适配），通过单一后端抽象实现模块化多速率执行与延迟优先融合推理。
papers.resultEn: On HY-VLA and pi0.5 it achieves 100% and 91% closed-loop task success, and a WAM benchmark cuts block memory from 312.2 MiB to 88.1 MiB.
papers.resultZh: 在HY-VLA与pi0.5上闭环任务成功率分别达100%与91%，WAM基准将块内存从312.2 MiB降至88.1 MiB。

papers.titleEn: OrbitQuant: Data-Agnostic Quantization for Image and Video Diffusion Transformers
papers.titleZh: OrbitQuant：面向图像与视频扩散Transformer的数据无关量化
papers.problemEn: Post-training quantization of diffusion transformers is hampered because activations shift across timesteps, prompts, and guidance branches, forcing re-fitting calibration data for every new checkpoint or modality.
papers.problemZh: 扩散Transformer的训练后量化受制于激活值随时间步、提示与引导分支漂移，每个新检查点或模态都需重新拟合校准数据。
papers.innovationEn: OrbitQuant quantizes in a normalized rotated basis where a randomized permuted block-Hadamard rotation concentrates each coordinate around one fixed marginal, so a single Lloyd-Max codebook serves all timesteps/layers; the rotation is absorbed into offline weights and cancels inside each linear layer at runtime.
papers.innovationZh: OrbitQuant在归一化旋转基下量化：随机置换块Hadamard旋转使每个坐标集中到固定边际分布，单一Lloyd-Max码本即可覆盖所有时间步与层；旋转被吸收进离线权重并在每个线性层内运行时抵消。
papers.resultEn: It sets SOTA for PTQ on FLUX.1, Z-Image-Turbo, Wan 2.1, and CogVideoX at several low-bit settings, and pushes image DiTs to W2A4 with usable quality, transferring image→video with no per-modality tuning.
papers.resultZh: 在FLUX.1、Z-Image-Turbo、Wan 2.1、CogVideoX多个低比特设定上创下PTQ新纪录，将图像DiT推至W2A4仍保持可用质量，且图像→视频无需按模态调参。

papers.titleEn: VLA-Corrector: Lightweight Detect-and-Correct Inference for Adaptive Action Horizon
papers.titleZh: VLA-Corrector：用于自适应动作时域的轻量检测-纠正推理
papers.problemEn: VLA policies use fixed-horizon action chunks for efficiency, but their predict-then-blindly-execute paradigm loses closed-loop reactivity, so small contact-rich perturbations amplify into compounding errors and task failure.
papers.problemZh: VLA策略采用固定时域动作分块以提效，但“预测后盲目执行”范式丧失闭环反应能力，接触丰富场景中的小扰动会被放大为累积误差与任务失败。
papers.innovationEn: VLA-Corrector adds a lightweight Latent-space Vision Monitor that compares predicted vs actual visual feature evolution to detect drift, then truncates stale actions and triggers corrective replanning via Online Gradient Guidance — yielding an event-triggered adaptive action horizon without retraining the backbone.
papers.innovationZh: VLA-Corrector引入轻量“潜空间视觉监视器”，对比预测与真实视觉特征演化以检测漂移，随后截断陈旧动作并通过在线梯度引导触发纠正重规划——形成事件触发的自适应动作时域，且无需重训骨干。
papers.resultEn: It integrates into multiple VLA models, interrupting compounding errors while preserving action-chunking efficiency and substantially improving robustness in long-horizon, contact-rich manipulation.
papers.resultZh: 可即插即用于多种VLA模型，在保留动作分块效率的同时打断累积误差，显著提升长时程、接触丰富操作任务的鲁棒性。

papers.titleEn: DataComp-VLM: Improved Open Datasets for Vision-Language Models
papers.titleZh: DataComp-VLM：面向视觉-语言模型的改进开放数据集
papers.problemEn: Building strong VLMs demands careful large-scale data curation, yet the field lacks systematic benchmarks for evaluating filtering, mixing, formatting, and sampling strategies across model and token scales.
papers.problemZh: 构建强VLM依赖大规模数据精筛，但业界缺乏系统基准来评估跨模型与token规模下的过滤、混合、格式化与采样策略。
papers.innovationEn: DCVLM assembles 160 datasets (6T multimodal tokens across image-caption, interleaved, text-only, instruction-tuning) into a controlled testbed for 1B–8B models and 6.25B–200B token budgets, evaluated on up to 52 benchmarks across 9 domains.
papers.innovationZh: DCVLM将160个数据集（6T多模态token，覆盖图像-字幕、交叠、纯文本、指令微调）整合为可控测试床，支持1B–8B模型与6.25B–200B token预算，在9领域52个基准上评测。
papers.resultEn: Data mixing — not filtering — is decisive; instruction-heavy mixtures scale best, and DCVLM-Baseline trains an 8B VLM to 63.6% on the 33-task core suite (+5.4pp over FineVision) with 200B tokens.
papers.resultZh: 决定性因素是数据混合而非过滤；指令偏重的混合扩展性最佳，DCVLM-Baseline以200B token训练8B VLM在33任务核心套件上达63.6%（较FineVision +5.4pp）。

papers.titleEn: Securing the AI Agent: A Unified Framework for Multi-Layer Agent Red Teaming
papers.titleZh: 保卫AI智能体：多层智能体红队的统一框架
papers.problemEn: Open-source AI infrastructure (serving engines, agent platforms, MCP, models) is growing faster than the security tooling to defend it, and no single detection paradigm fits every layer of an agent's attack surface.
papers.problemZh: 开源AI基础设施（推理引擎、智能体平台、MCP、模型）增长速度远超防御工具，且没有任何单一检测范式能覆盖智能体攻击面的每一层。
papers.innovationEn: AI-Infra-Guard matches a paradigm to each layer — deterministic rules over 75+ components and 1,400+ vulnerability rules, LLM-driven auditing of MCP servers/skills, multi-turn black-box agent red teaming, and a jailbreak harness with 26+ operators across 16 datasets — including supply-chain auditing of agent skills.
papers.innovationZh: AI-Infra-Guard为每层匹配范式：对75+组件与1400+漏洞规则的确定性匹配、对MCP服务器/技能的LLM驱动审计、多轮黑盒智能体红队、以及覆盖16数据集26+攻击算子的越狱测试框架——并包含智能体技能供应链审计。
papers.resultEn: It is the only open-source framework to span all these layers and paradigms, released for community use as a practical foundation for agent security.
papers.resultZh: 它是首个横跨上述所有层与范式的开源框架，已开放供社区作为智能体安全的实用基石。

papers.titleEn: Measuring the Gap Between Human and LLM Research Ideas
papers.titleZh: 度量人类与LLM研究想法之间的差距
papers.problemEn: LLMs are increasingly used to brainstorm research ideas, but prior evaluations judge individual ideas by novelty/feasibility rather than measuring how LLM ideation differs distributionally from human research taste.
papers.problemZh: LLM越来越多地用于研究想法头脑风暴，但已有评估多以新颖性/可行性评判单条想法，而非度量LLM生想在分布上与人类研究品味有何不同。
papers.innovationEn: The framework reverse-engineers the inspiring prior works behind high-quality human papers, prompts LLMs to generate ideas from those titles/summaries, and profiles each idea with a two-axis research-taste taxonomy (opportunity pattern × research paradigm) to quantify divergence.
papers.innovationZh: 该框架反向工程高质量人类论文背后的启发性先验工作，让LLM据此生成新想法，并用双轴研究品味分类法（机会模式×研究范式）刻画每条想法以量化差异。
papers.resultEn: Across LLMs there is a consistent gap: LLM ideas cluster around bridge-like opportunities and synthesis methods, while human references spread more broadly across gap-framing and contribution-construction styles.
papers.resultZh: 跨多个LLM存在一致差距：LLM想法集中在桥接型机会与综合方法，而人类参考文献在差距界定与贡献构造方式上分布更广。

papers.titleEn: MultAttnAttrib: Training-Free Multimodal Attribution in Long Document Question Answering
papers.titleZh: MultAttnAttrib：长文档问答中免训练的多模态归因
papers.problemEn: Grounded QA systems must attribute answers to evidence for trust and safety, but multimodal attribution in long-form documents remains under-researched and existing prompting approaches are slow.
papers.problemZh: 落地问答系统需将答案归因到证据以保障信任与安全，但长文档多模态归因研究不足，现有基于提示的方法延迟高。
papers.innovationEn: MultAttnAttrib is a training-free method that leverages a model's prefill pass, selected attention heads, and calibrated thresholds to locate source evidence; it is paired with MultAttrEval, the first long-form multimodal attribution benchmark with fine-grained ground truth.
papers.innovationZh: MultAttnAttrib是免训练方法，利用模型预填充阶段、选定注意力头与校准阈值定位源证据；并配套MultAttrEval——首个带细粒度真值的长文档多模态归因基准。
papers.resultEn: It outperforms strong prompting-based methods and matches GPT 5.4, improving unimodal and multimodal attribution accuracy at up to one-seventh the inference latency.
papers.resultZh: 它超越强提示方法并匹敌GPT 5.4，在单模态与多模态归因准确率上均有提升，且推理延迟仅为直接推理的七分之一。

papers.titleEn: Interpretation-Oriented Cloud Removal via Observation-Anchored Residual Flow with Geo-Contextual Alignment
papers.titleZh: 面向解译的云去除：观测锚定残差流与地理上下文对齐
papers.problemEn: Remote-sensing cloud removal methods prioritize visual realism but cause semantic drift that degrades downstream tasks like segmentation and change detection.
papers.problemZh: 遥感云去除方法重视觉真实而轻下游影响，导致语义漂移，损害分割、变化检测等后续任务。
papers.innovationEn: GACR reformulates cloud removal as a physically grounded residual inversion via Observation-Anchored Residual Flow (anchoring generation to the cloudy observation, not pure noise) and constrains reconstruction within a Vision Foundation Model semantic manifold via Geo-Contextual Prior Alignment.
papers.innovationZh: GACR通过观测锚定残差流将云去除重构为物理残差反演（将生成轨迹锚定于有云观测而非纯噪声），并通过地理上下文先验对齐将重建约束在视觉基础模型的语义流形内。
papers.resultEn: Across six cloud-removal datasets and twelve downstream tasks, GACR delivers superior reconstruction while consistently improving downstream accuracy.
papers.resultZh: 在6个云去除数据集与12个下游任务上，GACR在重建质量领先的同时持续提升下游任务精度。

papers.titleEn: AGE: Adaptive-masking for Graph Embedding in Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.titleZh: AGE：图检索增强生成中图嵌入的自适应掩码
papers.problemEn: GraphRAG struggles to represent graph-structured knowledge for frozen LLMs because graph-based and text-based latent features are misaligned, and standard masked SSL wastes effort masking key nodes that hold dominant context.
papers.problemZh: GraphRAG难以为冻结LLM表征图结构知识——图特征与文本特征潜在失配，且标准掩码SSL会把含主导上下文的关键节点掩掉造成浪费。
papers.innovationEn: AGE uses a Transformer with mask-based self-supervised learning designed like text encoders to fix the latent misalignment, and a learnable node sampler focuses masking on non-key nodes rather than dominant-context key nodes.
papers.innovationZh: AGE采用类文本编码器的Transformer掩码自监督学习修复潜在失配，并用可学习节点采样器聚焦掩码非关键节点而非主导上下文的关键节点。
papers.resultEn: AGE improves non-parametric search components in GraphQA, achieving superior accuracy across four benchmark datasets with distinct characteristics.
papers.resultZh: AGE改进了GraphQA中非参数搜索组件，在四个特性各异的基准数据集上取得更优准确率。

papers.titleEn: AnyBokeh: Physics-Guided Any-to-Any Bokeh Editing with Optical Fingerprint Transfer
papers.titleZh: AnyBokeh：基于光学指纹迁移的物理引导任意到任意散景编辑
papers.problemEn: Post-capture bokeh editing from a single image is hard because existing methods assume all-in-focus input or pre-recover an all-in-focus image, discarding useful source blur cues and propagating reconstruction artifacts.
papers.problemZh: 单图后处理散景编辑困难：现有方法假设全焦输入或先复原全焦图，丢弃了源图有用的模糊线索并放大重建伪影。
papers.innovationEn: AnyBokeh estimates source blur via a signed circle-of-confusion map and disparity map, derives a source-specific optical fingerprint, and a generative editor conditioned on source+target CoC maps performs relative blur synthesis for spatially adaptive deblurring/defocus.
papers.innovationZh: AnyBokeh用带符号弥散圆图与视差图估计源模糊，推导源专属光学指纹，并以源+目标弥散圆图为条件的生成编辑器执行相对模糊合成，实现空间自适应去模糊/虚化。
papers.resultEn: On real-world benchmarks it achieves faithful, controllable any-to-any bokeh editing, all-in-focus→bokeh rendering, and defocus effects, supported by a new high-fidelity synthetic dataset with depth and full EXIF metadata.
papers.resultZh: 在真实基准上实现忠实可控的任意到任意散景编辑、全焦→散景渲染与虚化效果，并构建带深度与完整EXIF元数据的高保真合成数据集。

papers.titleEn: Teaching LLMs to Recommend and Defer in Underrepresented Epilepsy Care
papers.titleZh: 教LLM在欠代表的癫痫诊疗中推荐与延后决策
papers.problemEn: In resource-constrained settings, LLM decision support for epilepsy must adapt to local prescribing practice and know when to defer, but standard prompting produces distribution-miscalibrated prescribing errors.
papers.problemZh: 在资源受限环境中，面向癫痫的LLM决策支持需适配本地处方实践并懂得何时延后，但标准提示会产生分布失配的处方错误。
papers.innovationEn: MANANA is a non-parametric prompt-learning framework that converts observed prescription errors into auditable prompt memories (single- and multi-agent), plus Bayesian prompt averaging that yields prescription likelihoods and an uncertainty-based deferral signal.
papers.innovationZh: MANANA是非参数提示学习框架，将观察到处方错误转化为可审计的提示记忆（单/多智能体），并用贝叶斯提示平均生成处方似然与基于不确定性的延后信号。
papers.resultEn: Across two Ugandan cohorts it beats classical ML, direct LLM prompting, and prompt-optimization baselines by 4–8pp top-3 accuracy, auto-handling the most confident half of cases at 95% precision.
papers.resultZh: 在两个乌干达队列上，其top-3处方准确率较经典ML、直接LLM提示与提示优化基线高4–8pp，可对最有信心的半数病例以95%精度自动处理。

papers.problemEn: Conventional image generators add content implicitly inside the model, so enrichment of a sparse scene description is not inspectable and lacks structural coherence.
papers.problemZh: 传统图像生成器将增补内容隐式藏在模型内部，稀疏场景描述的富化过程不可检视且缺乏结构一致性。
papers.innovationEn: Generated Contents Enrichment (GCE) makes enrichment explicit via a jointly trained adversarial framework that represents input as a scene graph and uses graph convolutional networks to predict additional objects and relations before rendering.
papers.innovationZh: 生成内容富化（GCE）通过联合训练的对抗框架将富化显式化：先把输入表示为场景图，再用图卷积网络预测额外对象与关系，最后再渲染。
papers.resultEn: Evaluated with scene-graph enrichment metrics, image-quality comparisons, qualitative examples, and user studies on Visual Genome, the framework yields visually plausible, structurally coherent, semantically richer content.
papers.resultZh: 在Visual Genome上以场景图富化指标、图像质量对比、定性示例与用户研究评估，框架生成视觉合理、结构连贯、语义更丰富的内容。
